title: Say the Right Thing
subject: English
summary: “Say the Right Thing” is a humorous play about a girl named Mary Shaw who often speaks without thinking. One day, her mother, Mrs. Shaw, invites two guests, Mrs. Harding and Mrs. Lee, to their home. Before they arrive, her mother advises Mary to speak politely and say pleasant things. However, Mary makes several funny mistakes by making comments about the guests' family members, clothes and pets without knowing that they are connected to them. This creates embarrassing situations for her mother. When the guests are leaving, Mary again uses the wrong words and asks, “Must you stay Can't you go” Everyone is surprised by her behaviour. The play teaches us that we should think before speaking and always choose our words carefully to avoid hurting or embarrassing others.
